source.run_attribution: Owner supplied these figures in direct response to the request for this Gemini 4 Argon workspace's costs. Attribution is owner-reported, not independently matched against a backend export.

comparison.note: Use only this amount for comparison with the old model-token estimates. Do not compare the media-inclusive total against old model-only values.

timing.note: Separate measurements. Neither the backend estimate nor the visible build-card timer replaces the browser-observed duration used for scoring. The delta is not attributed to a cause.
